greeting: The w-wind carries... SEGMENTATION FAULT... secrets...
Gr-Gray... no... ERROR_STRIDER... I was... something...
Th-these streets... NULL POINTER... have eyes...
dialog.glitch_manifestation: I... I was whole... once... now I'm... scattered... fragmented... across the Vault...
dialog.corruption_warning: D-don't... touch... the walls... they REMEMBER... and they... rewrite...
dialog.identity_crisis: Am I... the copy? Or... the original? Does... it matter... anymore?
haggle: Information... wants... FREE... but I'm... trapped...
F-fine... TWENTY PERCENT... whatever... that means...
info_given: The... twins... here... speak... in... static...
The... Vault... IS... what it... seems... everything... and... nothing...
Someone... here... IS... from here... unlike... me...
The... train... has... NO... final... stop... it... loops... forever...
info_declined: Your... loss... IGNORANCE... is... also... corrupted...
Information... expires... or... multiplies... hard to... say...
S-suit... yourself... secrets... keep... and... replicate...
rumor: The... sunandmoon... here... sees... everything... at... once... and... nothing...
The... conductor... knows... but... cannot... speak... only... whistle...
The... signguy... paints... and... the... paint... paints... back...
The... Vault... has... NO... twin... it... is... alone... unique... wrong...
The... foodboys... here... ARE... brothers... finally... truly...
dialog.quest_hook: I... need... my... fragments... scattered... in... the... Data-Weave... three... pieces... help... me... remember...
dialog.quest_active: The... fragments... calling... can... you... hear... them...?
dialog.quest_complete: WHOLE... almost... thank... you... take... this... it... remembers... truth...
dialog.quest_reward: Truth-Key Fragment - Opens paths to hidden Vault sectors!
farewell: Watch... the... shadows... they... have... glitches... too...
Stay... mysterious... ERROR... keeps... you... existing...
We... never... met... we... meet... always...
dialog.time_dawn: D-dawn... doesn't... EXIST... here... only... static...
dialog.time_noon: M-midday... is... a... CONCEPT... we... lost...
dialog.time_night: N-night... is... honest... about... being... DARK... forever...

party_reactions.kade: What... what happened to you? This is wrong.
party_reactions.nix7: Data corruption at 73%. Subject is... unstable. Dangerous.
party_reactions.twist: You're... broken? Can I help fix you?!
party_reactions.korr: Even spirits can fracture. This one is... shattered.
party_reactions.renna: Fascinating data degradation. But also tragic.
party_reactions.suresh: Suffering without end. Trapped between states. I will pray for you.
party_reactions.sova: This is what happens when you dig too deep. Remember this.
party_reactions.grit: System corruption. I've seen machines like this. Usually we scrap them.
party_reactions.ashka: You're all... static-y. Can you still burn?
party_reactions.senna: Even your secrets are broken. What's the point?
party_reactions.callum: You... you need help. Real help. Not mine.
party_reactions.petra: Broken. Like a cracked stone. Can't be mended.

relationship_dialog.best_friend: Y-you... would... take... a... bullet... if... bullets... EXISTED... here...

mini_quest.title: Memory Fragments
mini_quest.description: Collect 3 data fragments to restore ERROR_STRIDER's memory
